verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a wait-for-selector parameter or option that holds back the rendered page until a given selector appears. Support for Playwright and Puppeteer is only a developer building block. The client's "waits for it to finish" refers to waiting for an Actor run to complete, not for a DOM selector, so it is an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the API wait for a specific selector to appear before returning the rendered page
